state_transition.source: native best_bid_ask sequence, timestamp_received observable clock
state_transition.state_definition: per-token TRAIN-only spread tertiles; tokens require >=30 TRAIN native BBO observations and distinct cutpoints
state_transition.panel: 15-second clock; state and dwell are computed from the full native-BBO sequence before deterministic sample_mod=16
state_transition.target_definition: at least one future native BBO observation within horizon enters a spread-state different from state at t
state_transition.caveat: The target is transition occurrence, not direction.

resilience.source: native book depth snapshots, timestamp_received observable clock

shock_definition.depth: depth_5c drops >=25% versus previous snapshot for same token
shock_definition.spread: spread widens >=0.02 versus previous snapshot for same token
shock_definition.continuity: snapshot gap <=300s; otherwise no sequential shock claim

resilience.target_definition: future depth_5c recovers >=50% of the observed shock loss using the last snapshot at or before t+h, only when that future snapshot is <=60s old

statistics.fdr: BH q=0.10 within target_family x feature_family

admission: Only coordinates passing every frozen DEV gate may be added to PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE; otherwise retained as REJECTED_DISCOVERY or SUPPORT_BLOCKED.
